title: Data and normalized clauses of the finite and adic Galois correspondence
statement: For a scheme Y with geometric point y and a topological group G acting on the finite etale fibre, define the finite and adic correspondence data previously declared in cor-galois-lisse-representations. The finite representation category consists of finite R-modules with open point stabilizers. Finite data comprise γ, Φ, the represented-fibre comparison, the module equivalences and the module-stalk comparisons. The finite correspondence adds Yoneda, evaluation, abelian, kernel, cokernel, tensor, unit and actual balanced scalar-extension clauses. Adic data comprise the profinite model and the three coefficient-level equivalences and their fibre comparisons; the adic correspondence adds all original exactness, evaluation, tensor, unit and coefficient-extension clauses. These are exactly the former definitions, with unchanged names, universes, binders, fields and bodies; they use [def-galois-fibre-functor], [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-pod-lisse-l-adic-sheaves], [def-pod-l-adic-representations] and [def-pod-lisse-adic-fibre-functors]. The data are separated from the proof to permit the component theorems to import them without an import cycle. No mathematical object is chosen from a theorem here.
